profiles.abrasion: Yes. As with all glass-fiber-reinforced materials, the abrasive content will gradually wear down a standard brass nozzle. We recommend a hardened nozzle (e.g., hardened steel or ruby) with a diameter of at least 0.5mm, a 0.4mm nozzle is not recommended for this material.
profiles.nozzleMaterial: Yes. As with all glass-fiber-reinforced materials, the abrasive content will gradually wear down a standard brass nozzle. We recommend a hardened nozzle (e.g., hardened steel or ruby) with a diameter of at least 0.5mm, a 0.4mm nozzle is not recommended for this material.
profiles.nozzleDiameter: Yes. As with all glass-fiber-reinforced materials, the abrasive content will gradually wear down a standard brass nozzle. We recommend a hardened nozzle (e.g., hardened steel or ruby) with a diameter of at least 0.5mm, a 0.4mm nozzle is not recommended for this material.

notes.text: Recommended settings for printers with a 0.4 mm nozzle. Max. 50% layer height. Optimal settings may vary between printers and are also dependent on environmental factors. Yes.
